seo.title: Request an Automation Quote in Egypt | Logic Controls
seo.description: Request a quote for control panels, PLC/HMI programming, retrofits, SCADA or commissioning in Egypt. Send details by form, WhatsApp or email.

intro: Tell us about your machine or project. An engineer reviews every request and replies with questions, a site visit or a quote.

form.title: Quote request

steps.twoNote: Optional, but it helps us quote faster.

phone.label: Mobile or WhatsApp number
phone.help: For example +20 10 1234 5678, or your number with its country code.

email.label: Email
email.help: For drawings, documents and the written quote.

options.machine-retrofits: Retrofit or upgrade of an old machine
options.new-factory: New factory in Egypt: full automation scope
options.oem-partner: Machine builder: local commissioning and service for our machines

country.label: Country
country.help: Where your company is based, if outside Egypt.

message.label: Describe the machine or project
message.help: Machine type, what it should do, current problems, and PLC or HMI brands if you know them.

phoneOptional.label: Phone number
phoneOptional.help: Include the country code, for example +20 10 1234 5678.

files.label: Drawings, photos or documents
files.help: Up to {count} files, {size} in total: PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP, ZIP, DWG or DXF.

consent.text: I agree that Logic Controls may use these details to reply to my request, as described in the {link}.

whatsappHint.text: Prefer WhatsApp? Send photos of the machine, the nameplates, the panel or the drawings.

form.privacyNote: We use your details only to reply to this request. We do not add you to any mailing list.
form.sent: Request sent. Opening the confirmation page…
form.noscript: The security check needs JavaScript. If the form does not send, contact us directly by phone, WhatsApp or email.

prefill.intro: Hello Logic Controls, I tried to send this request through your website form:
prefill.subject: Quote request from the website

security.label: Security check
security.help: This check confirms that a person, not a bot, is sending the form.
security.waiting: The security check is taking longer than usual. Please wait a moment, or send the same request another way:

validation.name: Please enter your full name.
validation.phone: Please enter a valid phone number, including the country code.
validation.email: Please enter a valid email address.
validation.consent: Please confirm that we may use your details to reply.
validation.messageTooLong: Please keep the description under {max} characters.
validation.filesType: Some files have a type we cannot accept. Use PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP, ZIP, DWG or DXF.
validation.filesCount: Please choose up to {max} files. You can send the rest after submitting.
validation.filesSize: The files are larger than {max} in total. Remove some here and send them after submitting: the confirmation page gives you a request number to mention by email or WhatsApp.
validation.emailForReply: Add your email address so we can reply by email.

errors.title: Your request was not sent
errors.invalid: Some details are missing or not valid. Please check the form and try again.
errors.verification: The security check did not complete. Please try again, or contact us on WhatsApp.
errors.send: We could not send your request because of a technical problem. Please try again in a few minutes, or contact us on WhatsApp or by email.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again, or contact us on WhatsApp or by email.
errors.fallback: You can also reach us directly:
errors.attachments: The files could not be attached. You can attach up to 3 files, 4 MB in total (PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP, ZIP, DWG or DXF). Remove them and send the request, then send the files by email or WhatsApp.
errors.verificationBlocked: The security check could not load. A browser extension, a firewall or your network may be blocking it.
errors.handover: Your details are copied into the message, so you do not need to type them again.

phone.label: Phone
phone.text: Call to discuss your project with an engineer.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp
whatsapp.text: Send photos, videos and drawings straight from your phone.

email.label: Email
email.text: For documents, drawings and formal requests.

steps.title: We review your request
steps.text: An engineer reads your request and checks the photos and documents you sent.

steps.title: We contact you
steps.text: We call or message you with questions and, if needed, arrange a site visit.

steps.title: You receive a quote
steps.text: A written scope and quote, with the platforms, deliverables and schedule.

seo.title: Request Sent | Logic Controls
seo.description: Thank you for your request. An engineer from Logic Controls will review it and contact you.

thanks.h1: Thank you. Your request has been sent.
thanks.text: An engineer will review it and contact you on your preferred channel.

urgent.title: Is a machine stopped?
urgent.text: For urgent help, call or WhatsApp us now and mention your request.

more.title: Have photos or drawings?
more.text: Send them on WhatsApp or by email. They help us prepare the quote faster.

ref.label: Your request number
ref.hint: Mention it when you call us or send more files.
ref.whatsapp: Hello Logic Controls, this is about my website request {ref}. I am sending more files.

thanks.handoff: Hello Logic Controls, I am {name} from {company}. I just sent request {ref} ({need}) on your website. Here are the drawings and photos.
